Ruling: model error; f4952 p. 3, Who Must File: "you must file Form 4952 to claim a deduction for your investment interest expense. Exception. You don't have to file Form 4952 if all of the following apply." The reply's note says the Schedule D pages do not say when Form 4952 is filed and reads it as filed whenever the filer has investment interest (f4952.has_interest); the project reads f4952.required (Form 4952 used, an election on line 4g or interest paid or carried forward, and the filing test with its exception). The reply is true where the exception applies and the form is not filed (classm.sd.2.deepseek: project false, reply true). The reply was not given the Form 4952 pages that decide it (an interface gap of the review), but its reading contradicts the source. Reviewed again line-scoped as a T-150 sibling refresh (the readers of the gate-wave follow-up's rewritten lines, BUG-0466/0471, T-264; this line itself is unchanged). executable-triage-v2 (.transcription/triage/2025/sd.json; 1,747 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 120 partial records): 1,994 of 2,366 comparisons agree; differences {"project-refuses": 135, "project-unknown": 24, "value": 213}; on completed returns {"value": 67}.

Ruling: scope; i1040sd p. 15, Schedule D Tax Worksheet: complete it "if you file Form 4952 and you have an amount on line 4g", line 3: "Enter the amount from Form 4952 ..., line 4g". All 65 candidate-refuses are on returns the project refuses elsewhere (by return: refused): the candidate's filing test reads Form 4952 and Schedule B terms the project does not read at this line (f4952.unsupported 17, sb.line8 11, f4952.alternative_allocation 11, sb.unsupported 10, sb.fbar_required 9, sb.form8938 5, f4952.bad_dividends 2); the 9 project-refuses are cited gates (div.bad_components 6, div.unsupported 1, sales[s2].digital 1, sales[s1].digital 1); the 2 project-unknown withhold sales[s2].aggregate_eligible. Ruling: model error; i1040gi p. 31, Line 7a, Exception 1 (no capital losses, only box 2a capital gain distributions, no box 2b, 2c or 2d amounts) and i1040sd p. 10, Capital Loss Carryover Worksheet, 'Use this worksheet to figure your capital loss carryovers from 2024 to 2025 if your 2024 Schedule D, line 21, is a loss ... Ruling: model error; f1040sd p. 1, line 13, "Capital gain distributions. See the instructions"; i1040sd p. 11, Line 13, "See Capital Gain Distributions"; f1099div box 2a. The amount is box 2a, asked when the taxpayer or spouse received dividends or other distributions (the parent question div.any). The candidate gates the amount on div.has_capital_gain, which the project defines as sd.distributions_if_dividends > 0 (forms/2025/div.yaml), so the candidate line reads itself: triage reports "cycle at sd.distributions_if_dividends" on every comparison it does not trivially pass. executable-triage-v2 (`.transcription/triage/2025/sd.json`, pass da3c033dcfd8; 1,986 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 40 partial bases, 392 partial records): 32 of 2,878 comparisons agree; kinds {"candidate-unknown": 2846}; by return {"completed": {"candidate-unknown": 1017}, "incomplete": {"candidate-unknown": 631}, "refused": {"candidate-unknown": 1198}}; completed witnesses (all candidate-unknown, project $0.00): stage14.asset.hy_5yr, mq_7yr, mq_mixed, mq_not, bonus_100, bonus_40_before. The line-scoped prompt listed div.has_capital_gain as a derived gate without its definition (tooling observation in the lane note), but div.any, the actual parent question, was offered; a gate on 'there are capital gain distributions' cannot decide the distribution amount.
